units.title: Adopt the complete regular SnapshotStore and SnapshotIo API
tasks: Adopt complete regular SnapshotStore, StoreError, SnapshotIo and FsSnapshotIo APIs. Preserve immutable save_new/save_new_with_io/load, trusted operation ordering, no-replace hard-link publication, retained stages and may-have-published Io errors.

Keep all 341 projected lib lines, including 111 lines of three deterministic races, all 86 SnapshotIo lines, the 332-line eight-case RR13 regression file and the 103-line two-case connected file. Archive the whole 348-line donor and defer only its exact lines 17–23 held raw-factory-candidate initialized_creation declarations; no held API or feature is released.

Use a regular-only 14-line manifest with existing model/editor/persistence dependencies. Keep held optional initializer/metamodel dependencies and raw feature declaration archived; do not introduce substitutes, native FFI, Python storage or a database facade.
verification: Source review must prove current model to_json_bounded/from_json/elements/projection and transaction APIs plus editor rotation caller compatibility. Recount every formatted source/helper/fixture before execution; planned 337 production/896 authored leaves only four authored lines.

Root runs all 13 retained cases under verified Linux x86_64 builderbob/Samsung ownership: regular fresh-handle reopen, no-overwrite, symlink/ancestor/root policies, directory replacement, FIFO/socket/UTF8, exact 4 MiB/one-extra refusal, provisional oversized output before I/O and three deterministic admission/open races. Preserve prior FIFO timeout and all historical failures.

Use offline locked serial fmt/tests/all-target Clippy and applicable target checks. Reserve seven CI lines for the syson-workflow matrix entry, SYSON_TEST_DIR and a conditional ephemeral GitHub Ubuntu setup: sudo install an owned 0700 /workspace/syson-snapshots directory. This reviewed hosted-only setup changes no local administration or test/API guards; distinguish hosted filesystem behavior from local Samsung measurements. Recount actual formatting/repairs/wiring before execution and split before either hard cap is exceeded. Bound child lifetimes, retain cleanup proof and obtain independent source/executed-input review before exact-head publication.

units.title: Qualify the complete SnapshotIo fault contract and filesystem ranges
tasks: Adopt the entire 356-line, 13-case snapshot_failures.rs unchanged. Check each create/write/file-sync/publish/directory-sync/remove operation, partial writes, errors after publication/removal, collision/no-overwrite and retained prior/staged bytes through actual SnapshotIo.

Add a bounded actual release filesystem probe: fresh identical admitted document/IDs/history and owned directory each repetition; save then drop/reopen/load; verify full data and role identities. Keep exact/over 4 MiB refusal controls and add applicable owned read-only/permission-denial controls with modes restored and successful prior bytes checked. Those new controls are separate from the original 26 cases; count any probe/helper growth normally. Keep compilation outside timed work.

Report save/load separately with two warmups and seven raw samples per named representative workload, raw ranges and independently scoped process memory. State cache warmth and measured operations; no hard timing veto, p95/native speedup/capacity claim or inferred crash durability.
verification: Root reexecutes all 26 original cases on the final RR13a+RR13b source, not just13fault cases; preserve typed may-have-published errors, exact original bytes and operation sequences. An Io error alone never proves nonpublication or safe retry.

Independent reviewers inspect actual binary correctness assertions, raw save/load samples, limits and whole-process memory method; root owns serial compiler/filesystem subprocess scopes, source-before/after custody, cleanup, hosted checks and exact-head merge.
